description: This is an HTML file that serves as a front-end interface for database visualization and browsing. It includes styles, layout, and client-side scripts for loading and interacting with database tables and their data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the backend API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selection and loading latest data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses a database's tables list and loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML to display table data including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content in table cells for long strings or objects.
